_comment: Sample seminar plans, rendered by scripts/make-flowchart.py into flowchart.org.  Chapters are named by sheet ID (the Denote timestamp): [[ID]] renders as 'Chapter N, Title' with a link, [ID] as the number N with a link, <ID ID ...> as 'Chapters 3, 5 and 8' with links (in index order, runs of three or more compressed to 'N–M'), {ID} as the bare number N (for section and theorem numbers such as §{ID}.2).

plans.title: One semester, 13 sessions (main line)
plans.intro: Parts IV–V enter only through the inputs listed in §{20261125T021500}.2 of [[20261125T021500]], stated as black boxes.
sessions: [[20261124T214600]], the gain at the odd levels (state Thm {20261125T013700}.3.1, the credit at every inert prime)

plans.title: Full version, 25 sessions
after: Part VI states the ingredients in general: <20261125T020000 20261125T020100 20261125T020200 20261125T020300 20261125T020400>. These are reading for the presenters of the last two sessions rather than sessions of their own.

A second semester could take an arithmetic track: Chapters [20261125T014100], [20261125T014500] (two sessions), [20261125T014700] (two sessions) and [20261125T011000], then the side series: [[20261124T220500]] (two sessions) with [[20261124T221500]].

notes: Run Part III with two presenters per sheet for Chapters [20261124T214500] and [20261125T013700].
Give one 30-minute primer each on Galois cohomology (before Chapter [20261125T004100]) and on Harder–Narasimhan filtrations (before Chapter [20261125T000100]).
